description: From designer Louis Marino, "We went through many concepts to communicate this from having a young Kanye create the bear out of legos, to developing an entire class of fully articulated 4' robotic puppets. title: ⭐ What I Would Have Said At Virgil's Funeral [V9]
status_source_term: OG File | OG File | CD Quality
description: Track 2 on the October 2022 copy. Has mumble Ye vocals. Nicknamed "Always" by fans until the real name was revealed. Ironically, Ye confirmed it's name at the party where it was first officially previewed. Samples "Crazy Bout My Boifriend (Loopy)" by Sissy Nobby and interpolates "As" by Stevie Wonder. According to James Blake, the sample was Ye's idea, with James producing the rest. He would later go on to say that he considers the song finished and the mumble on the last verse is intentional. Original CDQ snippets leaked December 2022 & October 16th, 2023, with an HQ snippet also leaking February 17th, 2023.

title: T CUT PUFFER
description:
Background: Designed by Demna and his team, the T Cut Puffer was first officially revealed in the YGEBB Lookbook posted by Ye and The Gap, modeled by Aisha Potter.

The retail version did not feature any major changes from the lookbook/sample version. However, the initial prototype by Balenciaga had a shorter length and normal-fitting arms.

The T Cut Puffer was not released on yeezygap.com and only dropped on third-party sites for unknown reasons.

It features bungee cords at the neck of the hood and the bottom of the puffer to tighten it to the body, as well as a chest pocket.

Release Date: 05/27/2022

title: LS-03 YE LIVE (AT SOFI)
description:
Background: Designed by Mark Seekings and Jurgen Maelfeyt, the LS-03 YE LIVE was initially released at a Los Angeles Pop Up for Ye's Los Angeles Concerts at the Sofi Stadium.

Happybelly Vending hosted the sale outside the Sofi Stadium for days before and on the days of Ye's Los Angeles concerts.

The LS-03 features stars on the chest and sleeves, and "YE LIVE IN SOFI" and the Concert Dates on the back.

The release also had the price increased from the $20 it is on yeezy.com to $70. It is also made in the USA.

During the first concert, the LS-03 was released on bully.yeezy.com/collections/sofi for $75, a price increase. The red and yellow colorways started selling on the day of the first concert.
